fieldValues.title: Working on a group's work means joining that group
fieldValues.decision_question: How does someone outside a working group help with its work?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner on 2026-10-11, while unblocking general-lane work that no working group could claim (clerk#46, clerk#47); awaiting ratification.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Anyone may join a working group to accelerate its work, and while doing so works within that group's jurisdiction and practices. A delegated group's authority is never arbitrarily overridden.
fieldValues.rationale: Delegation means little if a faster actor can bypass it; joining keeps one consistent way of working.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When joining a group to accelerate it is routinely slower than the group's own members, or a group's practices block urgent work.
